mapper.select: SELECT sequence_no FROM agent_event WHERE run_id = #{id} ORDER BY sequence_no DESC LIMIT 1 FOR UPDATE
SELECT * FROM agent_event WHERE enterprise_id = #{enterprise} AND conversation_id = #{conversation} ORDER BY conversation_sequence DESC LIMIT 1 FOR UPDATE
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM agent_event WHERE event_id IN ( SELECT event_id FROM (SELECT e.event_id FROM agent_event e JOIN agent_run r ON r.enterprise_id = e.enterprise_id AND r.id = e.run_id WHERE r.finished_at < #{boundary} AND r.status IN ('completed','failed','cancelled') LIMIT 1000) expired_events)
mapper.select: SELECT enterprise_id, conversation_id FROM agent_event WHERE published_at IS NULL GROUP BY enterprise_id, conversation_id ORDER BY MIN(created_at) LIMIT #{limit}
